findings.text: The company was incorporated on 14 December 2018 and its status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 17 August 2023.
One insolvency case is on record: a members' voluntary liquidation, wound up on 21 December 2022 and dissolved on 17 August 2023.
The register shows 4 current officers, comprising 3 directors (PERSON 288, PERSON 289 and PERSON 290, each appointed 14 December 2018) and 1 other officer.
Across the 3 current directors checked, 108 other companies were found, of which 48 are dissolved, 41 active, 12 registered and 7 in liquidation.

Individual director checks show PERSON 288 with 50 other appointments shown (35 dissolved, 12 registered, 3 in liquidation), PERSON 289 with 50 shown (34 active, 11 dissolved, 5 in liquidation) and PERSON 290 with 50 shown (32 active, 14 dissolved, 4 in liquidation).
One person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1175, a company holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights, with the right to appoint and remove directors.
The register records 1 satisfied charge, with no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.

The accounts are last made up to 31 December 2020 and their overdue status is unknown, with no next due date recorded; the confirmation statement's overdue status is also unknown, with no last made-up date recorded.
